change.what: forward() now derives RESEARCHOS_SOURCE_MODE from the same selector the child validates - fixture only for check W07-G01 with no case, live for W07-G02 or for an empty check paired with case A05, and an empty mode for anything else. The empty default is deliberate: an unbound selection must still refuse loudly instead of being executed in whichever mode happened to be configured.
change.why_not_a_default_mode: A blanket mode would have widened the gate rather than closing the defect, which is the failure class this line has already been rejected for twice.

after_measured.finding: The child whitelist takes only W07-G01, W07-G02 and an empty check id, so no mode value can ever serve a CARD check-id. W07-02's registered verification command therefore needs its own handler, and fixing R3 does not by itself make W07-02 verifiable.
